title: Merge overlapping intervals
statement_markdown: Given an array of `intervals` where `intervals[i] = [starti, endi]`, merge all overlapping intervals, and return an array of the non-overlapping intervals that cover all the intervals in the input.
hints: Sort the intervals by their starting points.
explanation: Sort the intervals based on the start time. Iterate through the intervals, and if the current interval overlaps with the last merged interval, merge them by updating the end time.
complexity: O(n log n) time and O(n) space.
